name: The Escape
summary: Maybell Maclure seeks a way to leave her family and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. You bring her William Pestle's Invisibility Liquor, brewed with crystal kelp gathered across the region.

sections.title: A Concoction for True Love
sections.body: The Maclures and Stonefields have feuded for generations, leaving no room for courtship. Gramma Stonefield asks William Pestle, an alchemist at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, for help. Crystal kelp from nearby lakes gives Pestle what he needs to brew Invisibility Liquor. The brew can hide Maybell's escape from the Maclure homestead.

sections.title: Vanishing into the Woods
sections.body: Maybell Maclure takes the flask and slips into the trees toward Tommy Joe. Guilt at deceiving her kin troubles her, but devotion outweighs her fear of discovery. She drinks the liquor and vanishes before your eyes. Now she has a few moments with Tommy Joe beyond the watchful eyes of their feuding elders.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Escape?
aliases: where to pick up the escape
faq.answer: William Pestle, an apothecary and alchemical assistant at Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, gives you Invisibility Liquor after you bring him crystal kelp.

faq.q: What is the Invisibility Liquor used for?
faq.answer: The Invisibility Liquor lets Maybell Maclure turn invisible long enough to leave her family's farm and visit Tommy Joe Stonefield without provoking her relatives.

faq.q: Why do Maybell and Tommy Joe have to hide their relationship?
aliases: why can't maybell and tommy joe be together
faq.answer: The Maclure and Stonefield families are bitter rivals, and their deep hostility forbids an open courtship between their children.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver the potion to Maybell?
faq.answer: Maybell thanks you, torn between guilt and excitement, then drinks the brew. She vanishes before your eyes and slips away toward Tommy Joe.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into The Escape?
faq.answer: The Escape follows Collecting Kelp. There, you gather crystal kelp from murlocs at Crystal Lake for William Pestle to brew the invisibility potion.

faq.q: Does this quest resolve the feud between the families?
faq.answer: No. The potion gives the lovers only a brief, secret meeting. The feud between Gramma Stonefield and the Maclures remains bitter and unresolved.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer starting in Elwynn Forest, helping Tommy Joe and Maybell offers a lighthearted break from fighting Defias bandits and gnolls. Rural grudges persist even near Stormwind.
As a human in Elwynn, you know stubborn family grudges run deep. Small acts of secret aid between neighbors can help keep the peace.
